creature_text.Text: Vile beasts of the nightmare, you will never take my claws!
Yes, Lord Xavius! I'll be happy to tear them apart in your name!
AAARRRRGGGHHHH!!! THE CLAWS! THEY THIRST FOR BLOOD!!
It is finished! The claws are ours!
You did it, $n! You got him!
We should go. There's nothing left for us here. Let me know when you're ready to leave and I'll take us back to our bodies in the normal world.
The ritual I'm about to perform is complicated, and will take some time to finish, but it is the only way to drop the barrier.
